verdict: Rocket Lab grew revenue 63% to a record $200M and lifted its backlog to a record $2.2B, but research and overhead still outran its gross profit, leaving a $45M loss.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue was a record $200M, up from $123M in Q1 2025

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP, diluted)
kpis.note: Basic and diluted; net loss was $45M, vs −$0.12 and a $61M loss a year earlier

kpis.label: Backlog
kpis.note: Orders booked but not yet flown or built; up 108% year over year and 20% in the quarter

kpis.label: Cash
kpis.note: Cash and equivalents at March 31, plus $271M in marketable securities

segments.name: Product revenues
segments.note: Spacecraft, satellite components and systems sold — reaction wheels, propulsion, solar power and the Photon spacecraft platform.

segments.name: Service revenues
segments.note: Launch services (Electron and HASTE missions) and mission services — flying and operating things in space for customers.

opex.name: Research and development, net
opex.note: Developing the Neutron rocket, Electron and spacecraft — up 46% from $55M a year earlier.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Running and selling the company — up 32% from $39M a year earlier, including deal work on acquisitions.

takeaways.title: The order book doubled
takeaways.text: Backlog hit a record $2.2B, up 108% YoY: 31 new Electron and HASTE contracts plus five dedicated Neutron launches were signed in the quarter — more launches sold than in all of 2025.

takeaways.title: Best gross margin yet
takeaways.text: GAAP gross margin reached a record 38.2%, up from 29% a year ago, as higher-margin space systems work grows faster than launch.

takeaways.title: Losses are narrowing
takeaways.text: The net loss shrank from $61M a year ago to $45M even as R&D rose to $81M — the Neutron program is the big deliberate spend standing between Rocket Lab and break-even.

oneTimers: Rocket Lab closed its acquisition of Mynaric (laser communications terminals for satellites) in the quarter and agreed to buy Motiv Space Systems — deal costs sit inside SG&A, and the acquired businesses add to revenue from here on.
otherDetail: Other income was $9.2M net: $10.1M of interest income on the large cash pile, partly offset by $1.3M of interest expense, plus small foreign-exchange and other gains.
footerNote: Net loss is the filed $45.0M; the loss per share was −$0.07.

sources.label: Official earnings release — Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
